summary: No findings. The continuation preserves strict proposal validation: PermissionContext is advertised inline without $defs/$ref, while JSON-string permissions, nested extras, altered scope/dates, SQL, unknown tools, duplicate or unauthorized artifacts, and empty proposals are rejected before governed retrieval. Caller permission and dates are explicitly authoritative and must exactly match the validated proposal. tool_choice='auto' permits abstention without weakening the requirement for one governed_query before execution. The configured provider performs one SDK request with zero retries and has no client-side model switch or fallback; retrieved data is never sent to a subsequent model turn. Raw prompt/completion counts are type- and range-validated before execution and propagated exactly into execution or rejection audits. Deterministic rendering retains the original manifest and accurately labels overdue results as customer-level observations, not confirmed invoice-level balances or complete totals. The retained live report proves the narrow recorded connection from the stated overdue-invoice/ticket question to v0.1.0/overdue_balances: one captured request, matching tool arguments, governed result/audit/proof identity, and exact usage. It does not prove general model reliability, invoice-by-invoice capability, or provider-side model identity/routing; notably, the request names glm-5.3-flash:cloud while the response reports glm-5.3-flash. Independently run without live inference: tests/test_agent.py (38 passed, one existing warning) and tests/test_queries.py plus tests/test_proof.py (44 passed, two existing warnings); git diff checks remained clean. No files were created, edited, staged, or committed.
